newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC DEFEAT FAILS TO STOP CROATS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC DEFEAT FAILS TO STOP CROATS.

text.p: Top seeds Croatia survived an early scare to beat Australia 2-1 after Goran Ivanisevic fell to Mark Philippoussis on the first day of the Hopman Cup mixed teams tennis tournament on Sunday.

Philippoussis, 20, took only 59 minutes to dispose of the world number four 6-2 6-3 to level the tie at 1-1 after Iva Majoli drew first blood for the Croats with a 6-4 6-3 victory over Nicole Bradtke.
In the deciding doubles tie, the Croatian pair secured the Group A victory with a 7-5 7-5 victory.
In a battle of two of the game's biggest servers, Philippoussis, ranked 30 in the world, blasted his rival off court with 15 aces compared to Ivanisevic's five.
The Hopman Cup is divided into two groups, with the remaining teams in Group A, France and the United States due to meet later in the day.
On Monday, second seeds Switzerland meet Romania and South Africa take on Germany.
